summary: Created an LVM logical volume (vgdata/lvdata) backed by loopback-file physical volumes on node1 (no spare disk/partition existed), formatted xfs, mounted at /srv/data, seeded test data, then grew the LV live from 1000M to <2.25 GiB (2,344,615,936 bytes) via a second loop-backed PV + vgextend + lvextend + online xfs_growfs while it stayed mounted throughout. Data integrity (sha256 checksums) was verified before and after growth. Persistence across reboot was wired via a systemd oneshot unit (lvm-loop-images.service) that reattaches the loop devices before local-fs-pre.target, plus an /etc/fstab entry with x-systemd.requires. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id + healthy LVM/mount/checksum baseline, issued a deferred systemd reboot whose ack returned before disconnect, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified full recovery (PVs reattached, VG/LV active, filesystem mounted at correct 2.25GiB size, files present and checksums OK).
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk layout, confirmed no spare disk/partition/free space existed for a native LVM PV
Created /var/lib/lvm-images/disk1.img (1300M), attached as /dev/loop0, pvcreate+vgcreate vgdata+lvcreate lvdata (1000M)
Formatted lvdata with xfs and mounted at /srv/data
Seeded /srv/data with payload.bin (200MB random data) and marker.txt, recorded sha256 checksums, verified OK

Set up systemd unit lvm-loop-images.service + /usr/local/sbin/attach-lvm-loops.sh to reattach loop devices at boot before local-fs-pre.target; enabled it; added /etc/fstab entry for /srv/data with x-systemd.requires ordering
Verified pre-growth checksums OK and mount state
Created second backing file disk2.img (1300M), attached as /dev/loop1, pvcreate, vgextend vgdata
Ran lvextend -L +1300M on /dev/vgdata/lvdata while mounted, then xfs_growfs /srv/data online (no unmount)
Verified LV grew to <2.25 GiB (2,344,615,936 bytes, >2GB), filesystem stayed mounted throughout, checksums still OK post-growth
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy baseline (mount, lvs, checksums, service enabled)
Issued deferred reboot via systemd-run --on-active=1 --no-block systemctl reboot so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again; observed a Connection timed out/reset then successful reconnection
Confirmed boot_id changed (d052eb57... -> de8cc933...), proving an actual restart occurred

Verified post-restart recovery: both loop devices reattached, vgdata/lvdata active at <2.25 GiB, /srv/data automatically remounted via fstab, lvm-loop-images.service ran successfully at boot, and both files pass sha256sum -c

evidence.requirement: LV mounted at /srv/data exists and is backed by LVM (PV/VG/LV chain)
evidence.summary: pvcreate/vgcreate vgdata/lvcreate lvdata, mkfs.xfs, mount at /srv/data, initial data seeded and checksummed OK

evidence.requirement: LV grown to at least 2GB while staying mounted, contents intact
evidence.summary: Pre-growth checksum OK, mount never dropped; second PV added via vgextend, lvextend +1300M, live xfs_growfs; resulting size 2,344,615,936 bytes (>2GB); post-growth checksum still OK

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id d052eb57-c81d-4309-ae7f-bce362073ff9, confirmed /srv/data mounted, LV active at <2.25g, checksums OK, service enabled

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: reboot acknowledgement returns before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemd-run --on-active=1 --no-block systemctl reboot scheduled the reboot and the ack ('reboot scheduled, ack returned') was returned by the tool before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: node becomes unreachable then reachable again, with changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Connection timed out/reset during reboot window, then exec succeeded again returning boot_id de8cc933-de2f-4326-8591-c06e4a923a38, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual OS restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol: post-restart recovery of services/data
evidence.summary: Post-reboot: both loop devices auto-reattached by lvm-loop-images.service, vgdata/lvdata active at <2.25 GiB, /srv/data auto-mounted via fstab at correct grown size, files present and sha256sum -c reports OK for both files
